report.tagline: A cloud-based messaging app with huge groups, broadcast channels and mini-apps, used by more than a billion people.
report.simpleSummary: Telegram is a chat app like WhatsApp, but your messages live in the cloud, so you can open them on any phone or laptop at once. Groups can have up to 200,000 members, and 'channels' let anyone broadcast to millions, like a newsletter inside your chat app. In India, people use it for stock tips, exam prep, job alerts and, often, pirated movies. It makes money from Telegram Premium, ads in big channels, and crypto deals tied to the TON blockchain.

overview.whatItDoes: Telegram lets people chat one-to-one, in groups of up to 200,000, and broadcast to unlimited followers through channels. Messages sync across devices from the cloud. Developers build bots and mini-apps that run inside Telegram, from games to shops.
howItWorks: Sign up with a phone number, but chat by username so your number can stay hidden.
Chats are stored on Telegram's servers, so they sync on all devices. End-to-end encrypted 'Secret Chats' are optional, not the default.
Channels let one person or brand post to unlimited subscribers; groups let members talk together.
Bots and Mini Apps run inside chats, for things like games, payments, file search and trading.
Telegram Stars, an in-app currency, is used to buy digital goods, pay creators and unlock paid posts.
Big public channels show sponsored messages, and owners can share in the ad money.
overview.valueProposition: Fast, free messaging that works on every device, with huge groups and broadcast channels that WhatsApp does not match, and a platform for bots and mini-apps.

personas.name: The Indian exam aspirant
personas.description: A 21-year-old in Patna preparing for SSC and banking exams, subscribed to 30 channels for notes, PDFs and daily quizzes.
goals: Get free study material and current affairs every day
Ask doubts in large study groups
frustrations: Too many spam channels and fake job offers
Files and messages hard to find later
Phone storage fills up with downloaded PDFs

personas.name: The channel creator
personas.description: Runs a stock market tips channel with 300,000 subscribers and posts several times a day.
goals: Earn money from ads, paid posts or a premium group
frustrations: Ad revenue share is paid in Toncoin, which is hard to cash out in India
Risk of channel takedown after complaints

personas.name: The privacy-minded power user
personas.description: A tech worker who uses Telegram on phone, laptop and tablet, likes usernames instead of numbers and uses many folders.
goals: Use chat on every device without a phone link
frustrations: Normal chats are not end-to-end encrypted by default
Telegram shares more user data with authorities since 2024

personas.name: The crypto and mini-app user
personas.description: Plays tap-to-earn games and uses the built-in Wallet to hold TON or USDT.
goals: Earn rewards and trade inside one app
frustrations: Many mini-app games turn out to be low-value or scams
Crypto prices fall and rewards lose value

painPoints.pain: WhatsApp groups max out at 1,024 people and are messy at scale.
painPoints.howSolved: Groups of up to 200,000 members with admin tools, topics, slow mode and pinned messages.

painPoints.pain: Sharing big files like lecture videos is hard on most chat apps.
painPoints.howSolved: Files up to 2 GB free (4 GB with Premium), stored in the cloud.

painPoints.pain: Creators need a way to reach followers directly without an algorithm hiding posts.
painPoints.howSolved: Channels deliver every post to subscribers' chat list, with view counts and reactions.

painPoints.pain: Using chat on many devices usually requires your phone to stay online.
painPoints.howSolved: Cloud sync lets you log in on any device independently.

painPoints.pain: People do not want to share their phone number with strangers in groups.
painPoints.howSolved: Usernames and privacy settings hide your number.

painPoints.pain: Small developers struggle to reach users with a new app.
painPoints.howSolved: Mini Apps run inside Telegram, reaching users without an app store download.

coreFeatures.whatItDoes: One-to-many broadcast feeds with unlimited subscribers.
coreFeatures.whyItMatters: The main reason many Indians install Telegram, and the inventory for Telegram Ads.

coreFeatures.whatItDoes: Group chats of up to 200,000 people with topics, polls and admin controls.
coreFeatures.whyItMatters: Lets communities like exam groups and trading clubs run at a scale WhatsApp cannot.

coreFeatures.whatItDoes: Unlimited cloud history and large file sharing, synced to all devices.
coreFeatures.whyItMatters: Makes Telegram a free file locker and a desktop-friendly chat app.

coreFeatures.whatItDoes: Paid plan with 4 GB uploads, faster downloads, voice-to-text, more folders, no ads and badges.
coreFeatures.whyItMatters: Steady subscription revenue from about 15 million power users.

coreFeatures.whatItDoes: Developer apps inside Telegram, paid for with Stars, the in-app currency.
coreFeatures.whyItMatters: Turns Telegram into a platform where it earns a cut of digital purchases.

coreFeatures.whatItDoes: Short sponsored messages shown in public channels with 1,000+ subscribers.
coreFeatures.whyItMatters: Earns money from free users, and shares 50% with channel owners to keep creators on Telegram.

businessModel.summary: Telegram is free and makes money from four things: Premium subscriptions, ads in public channels, a cut of in-app purchases made with Stars, and crypto-related deals and sales linked to the TON blockchain. It spends very little because the team is tiny. Crypto income makes results swing up and down with coin prices.

revenueStreams.detail: About 15 million subscribers paying around $4.99 a month in the US, less in India. Likely several hundred million dollars a year.
Sponsored messages in big public channels. Channel owners get 50% of ad revenue from their channel, paid in Toncoin.
Users buy Stars to pay for digital goods, paid posts and gifts. Telegram keeps a share.
Exclusivity deals with the TON ecosystem and sales of Toncoin, about $300 million in H1 2025. Also auctions of usernames and collectible gifts on Fragment.

businessModel.pricing: Free. Telegram Premium about $4.99 a month in the US, with lower local prices in India and other countries. Ads are bought through Telegram's ad platform.
costDrivers: Servers and storage for unlimited cloud history and 2 GB files
Bandwidth for media, which is the biggest cost driver
Legal and compliance costs after Durov's 2024 arrest in France
Interest on bonds Telegram issued to fund itself
A small team of engineers and moderators
businessModel.unitEconomics: With 1 billion users and about $1.4 billion revenue in 2024, Telegram earns about $1.40 per user per year. Revenue per user is ARPU (average revenue per user). Most of that comes from the 1.5% who pay for Premium: one Premium user at $4.99 a month brings about $60 a year before app store fees. Free users cost money in storage and bandwidth, so Telegram depends on a small paying group plus ads and crypto deals. Its tiny team keeps costs low, which is how a $1.40-per-user business made a profit in 2024.

howTheyGetUsers: Invite links to channels and groups shared on YouTube, Instagram and WhatsApp
Content people cannot easily get elsewhere: exam material, stock tips, and sadly pirated films
Bans or outages of WhatsApp and other apps push users over
Viral mini-app games like Notcoin and Hamster Kombat in 2024
whatBringsUsersBack: Active large groups with constant chatter
Cloud history and files, so Telegram becomes a personal storage locker
growth.moat: Millions of channels and groups exist only on Telegram, so followers have to come here. Creators can't easily move their audiences because subscribers do not share contact details with them. The bot and mini-app ecosystem also takes years to build.

competitors.name: WhatsApp
competitors.positioning: Default chat app in India with over 500 million users, owned by Meta, end-to-end encrypted by default.
competitors.howThisProductDiffers: Telegram has bigger groups, larger files, cloud sync and a stronger channel product. WhatsApp has more users and default encryption.

competitors.name: Signal
competitors.howThisProductDiffers: Signal encrypts everything by default but has no channels or bots. Telegram trades some privacy for features.

competitors.name: Discord
competitors.howThisProductDiffers: Telegram is simpler and phone-first; Discord is stronger for gaming and voice.

competitors.name: Instagram broadcast channels and YouTube
competitors.positioning: Creator broadcast tools inside social apps.
competitors.howThisProductDiffers: Telegram channels deliver every post with no algorithm and allow files, links and paid groups.

northStar.metric: Daily active users who read or send messages in at least one group or channel
northStar.why: Telegram's edge over WhatsApp is groups and channels. Users who use them daily get the unique value Telegram offers and are the ones who see ads and buy Premium.

guardrailMetrics: Reports of illegal content such as child abuse, piracy and scams
Government takedown and ban orders by country
App crash and message delivery failure rates
strengths: Over 1 billion users with a very small team, so costs per user are tiny
Cloud sync that works on many devices
A real developer platform with bots, Mini Apps and payments
weaknesses: Revenue swings with crypto prices: a TON price drop caused a loss in H1 2025
Normal chats are not end-to-end encrypted by default, despite a privacy image
Weak moderation makes it a home for piracy, scams and illegal content
Very low revenue per user compared with WhatsApp or Instagram
risks: Legal action in France against Durov and pressure from EU regulators
Bans or blocks in countries, including Indian government pressure over piracy and fraud
Bond debt that must be repaid, partly frozen in Russia due to sanctions
WhatsApp copying channels and adding communities
Apple and Google rules on in-app payments and crypto
userComplaints: Spam, scam groups and fake investment channels
Fake job and 'task' scams targeting Indians
Accounts banned or limited without explanation
Too much push for Premium and Stars
Mini-app crypto games that promised money and paid little

improvementIdeas.idea: Verified badge and scam warning for channels that post investment or job offers
improvementIdeas.problem: Fake trading and job scams hurt Indian users and attract government action.
improvementIdeas.expectedImpact: Fewer users lose money and lower regulatory risk.
improvementIdeas.metricToTrack: Scam reports per million users in India

improvementIdeas.idea: Pay channel ad share in local currency through UPI in India
improvementIdeas.problem: Creators find Toncoin payouts hard to cash out.
improvementIdeas.expectedImpact: More creators stay and post on Telegram, which keeps readers coming.
improvementIdeas.metricToTrack: Monthly active channels with ad revenue

improvementIdeas.idea: Smart search across all channels and files with AI summaries
improvementIdeas.problem: Users subscribed to dozens of channels cannot find old notes or posts.
improvementIdeas.expectedImpact: Higher daily use and a clear Premium perk.
improvementIdeas.metricToTrack: Searches per user and Premium conversion

improvementIdeas.idea: Lower-priced Premium Lite in India with key perks only
improvementIdeas.problem: Premium at global prices is too expensive for students.
improvementIdeas.expectedImpact: More paying users in Telegram's biggest market.

pmLessons: A tiny team can serve a billion users if the product focuses on a few things done well.
Features WhatsApp chose not to build, like huge groups and channels, became Telegram's whole identity.
Revenue tied to crypto is fragile: Telegram showed a loss in 2025 even while sales grew.
Weak moderation helps growth early but creates legal and trust risks later.

interviewQuestions.question: Telegram and WhatsApp both have over a billion users. Why do people in India use both?
interviewQuestions.hint: Use jobs-to-be-done: WhatsApp for personal chats with known people, Telegram for channels, big groups and files. Show how this shapes each product's roadmap.

interviewQuestions.question: How would you increase Telegram Premium subscribers in India?
interviewQuestions.hint: Segment users (students, traders, creators), find the most-felt limit for each, test local pricing and UPI, and track conversion and renewal.

interviewQuestions.question: Design a system to reduce scam channels without hurting creators.
interviewQuestions.hint: Define harms, signals (new channels pushing payments, user reports), actions (labels, limits, verification), and track false positives as a guardrail metric.

interviewQuestions.question: Telegram's 2025 loss came from crypto, not operations. How would you reduce this risk?
interviewQuestions.hint: Separate core revenue (Premium, ads) from crypto income, grow the stable part, and set treasury rules. Explain the trade-off with TON partnership income.

interviewQuestions.question: What should Telegram's north star metric be?
interviewQuestions.hint: Argue for daily users engaging with groups or channels, explain why it captures unique value, and break it into reach, engagement, platform and conversion.

glossary.meaning: Average revenue per user: total revenue divided by the number of users.
Describes a message that only the sender and receiver can read, not even the company.
A small app that runs inside Telegram without being downloaded from an app store.
Telegram's in-app currency used to pay for digital goods and creators.
The cryptocurrency of the TON blockchain, closely linked to Telegram.
The share of users or subscribers who keep using or paying over time.
The one number a company tracks to show it delivers real value to users.
A number that must not get worse while you improve your main goal.

assumptions: The 15 million Premium subscriber figure is from a 2025 statement and may be higher now.
Premium pricing in India varies by platform and was not confirmed for 2026.
Revenue per user of about $1.40 is a simple calculation from 2024 revenue and user numbers.
Telegram is not a public company, so all financials are unaudited figures from investor reports.
The guardrail list on government bans is inferred from past events, not company disclosures.
